source.title: Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum and reversal
source.author: Milan Fičura

hypothesis: Among liquid cryptocurrencies, closing near the recent k-week high predicts positive subsequent weekly returns, reflecting momentum rather than the reversal documented for illiquid coins.
universe: Frozen ex-ante Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals listed by 2021-12-31, including later-delisted contracts where data exist. Each Monday retain top 50 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume.
feature: Previous completed day's close divided by the maximum completed daily close over the prior K days. Higher values mean closer to the recent high.
portfolio: Equal-weight market-neutral long highest-nearness quintile and short lowest-nearness quintile, 0.5 gross per side.
execution: Feature/liquidity inputs end Sunday; rebalance Monday 00:00 UTC open and hold to next Monday open.
development_gate: Canonical rank IC >0.02 with HAC p<0.05, positive high-minus-low spread, canonical net Sharpe >0.70 and total return >0, and at least 2/3 windows positive after costs.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; OOS rank IC >0.02; positive at 2x costs; at least 2/3 windows positive; 2024 and 2025 non-negative; max drawdown <35%; excluding BTC/ETH positive; excluding strongest contributor positive; DSR reported.
notes: Canonical 7-day horizon is source-driven, not selected from this repository's results. This is distinct from the prior 52-week anchoring test.
